item.title: desktop Copilot app
item.description: The GitHub Copilot app is the only desktop experience for agent-driven development built natively on GitHub for macOS, Windows, and Linux. (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Redact: An Alternative 'Projection' of React
item.description: An alternative logical projection of React with 100% API compliancy but simpler implementation resulting in smaller bundle size and better performance. - TanStack/redact (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments. The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (2 sources: githubblog, reactstatus)

item.title: Props Are Not a Design System
this Japanese blog post
item.description: TanStack Redact は、React のコンポーネントや Hooks の書き方を引き継ぐ軽量ランタイムです。同期描画を採用しており、React と同じ API があっても動作が異なる部分があります。この記事では基本的な導入方法と設計思想を説明し、同じ商品一覧を React と Redact で動かし、startTransition の動作の違いを確かめます。 (1 source: reactstatus)
